hypothesis: At e<=0.7 the accel_step control R2 was intermediate (0.54-0.56), but the final margin (0.24-0.26) and the persistent formation step (60-70) already matched the e<=0.85 regime. So margin and timing switch to their high-e values somewhere between e ceilings of 0.5 and 0.7, while the control R2 declines gradually. At e in [0, 0.6] (N=64, 4 layers, d_model=64, m2 in [0.1, 1], seeds 70-72, settings matched to the e<=0.7 run), the control R2 is intermediate, roughly 0.58-0.70. The final margin is >= 0.20 and the persistent 0.1-bar formation step is <= 75, read from the trajectory.
expected_if_true: In all 3 seeds, the layer-4 accel_step best-of-5 control R2 is in [0.58, 0.70], the final accel_step margin is >= 0.20, and the persistent 0.1-bar formation step is <= 75. That would mean the margin and timing jump happens at an e ceiling of 0.6 or below, and the control R2 changes smoothly.
expected_if_false: In at least 2 of 3 seeds, the final margin is <= 0.18 or the persistent formation step is >= 80, which is e<=0.5-like timing at an intermediate control R2. That would place the switch between 0.6 and 0.7, or show it to be gradual. A control R2 >= 0.71 would instead mean the control falls non-linearly between e ceilings of 0.6 and 0.7.
